FAQ

Common questions.

Does it run my ads?
No. It writes the copy; you paste it into Google Ads, Meta or wherever you advertise.
Can I write social posts too?
Yes — that's the Social Media Generator.
Is what I enter stored?
No. What you enter is used to write your result and isn't kept afterward. The only things Workblox Business saves are your business profile and, if you use it, your Contacts list. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Ad Copy Writer is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
